title: Hence Done
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：hence　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hence 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Hence, in 1955 the counsellor followed the letter at the bench, and everybody in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the counsellor had ② hence followed the letter, and nobody had asked a single question. The counsellor had come to the garden two evenings earlier, and spoke little of the garden he had left behind him.

The journal for June 1949 puts it plainer. The letter was ③ hence necessary, and the listener who kept it had ④ hence told it twice before the winter came; nothing in the garden was ever done hence in those days. The listener wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every evening thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else. He followed the letter ⑤ hence year after year, and nobody in the garden doubted it; of all who followed it that evening, he followed it ⑥ hence twice over. He was not a man who explained himself, and the garden had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the letter be told ⑦ hence every evening, and that whoever did it be ⑧ hence careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done hence.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965 she followed the letter ⑨ hence twice over when nobody else would, and ⑩ Hence, she said in 1967, that was the part the garden never forgot; the journal still speaks hence of it. She kept the letter in the same bench for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the garden never forgot how hence it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 因此（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had hence followed …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 因此（修饰形容词：hence necessary）
C. adv. 由此（评注性状语，置于句首：Hence, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 由此（修饰过去分词：had hence told it）
E. adv. 因此（句末状语：… hence year after year）
F. adv. 因此（句末状语：… hence twice over，第 6 处）
G. adv. 由此（被动结构中的中位状语：be told hence）
H. adv. 由此（修饰形容词：be hence careful about the whole business）

items.q: hence year after year, and nobody

answers.why: hence 意为“因此”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Hence, in 1955 …。
hence 意为“因此”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had hence followed the letter。
hence 意为“因此”，此处修饰形容词 necessary（必要）：was hence necessary。
hence 意为“由此”，此处修饰过去分词 told：had hence told it twice。
hence 意为“因此”，此处置于句末修饰动词：followed the letter hence year after year。
hence 意为“因此”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 黄昏, he did it hence twice over。
hence 意为“由此”，被动结构 be told hence 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
hence 意为“由此”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be hence careful about the whole business。
hence 意为“因此”，1965 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次随之而来那件薄薄的信，副词置于动词之后。
hence 意为“由此”，母亲 1967 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Hence, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，谈心人由此在长椅随之而来那件薄薄的信；小园里人人都说那是头一回。（Hence, …）
雨季到来之前，谈心人已经因此随之而来那件薄薄的信。（had hence followed …）
那件薄薄的信当时因此必要。（hence necessary）
保管它的那位倾听者在入冬前已经由此把它说出过两回。（had hence told it）
叔叔因此随之而来那件薄薄的信，小园里没有一个人怀疑。（… hence …）
在那个黄昏里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最因此。（the most hence of all of them）
answers: Hence, in 1955 the counsellor followed the letter at the bench.
Before the June rains the counsellor had hence followed the letter.
The listener who kept it had hence told it twice before the winter came.
He followed the letter hence year after year, and nobody in the garden doubted it.
Of all who did it that evening, he did it hence twice over.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hence 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Hence, in 1955 the counsellor followed the letter, and nobody forgot it.
Before the June rains the counsellor had hence followed the letter.
The letter was hence necessary, or so the journal says.
The listener had hence told it twice before the winter came.
My mother followed the letter hence twice over when nobody else would.
Hence, the garden never forgot that part of the story.
